records.summary: The Magic Eden Help Center says the Bitcoin/Runes API and related backend services were fully shut down after March 27, 2026. Developers were directed to export data and migrate dependencies; Magic Eden did not offer alternative infrastructure.
records.title: Magic Eden Bitcoin/Runes API and backend services discontinued
records.user_impact: Bitcoin/Runes integrations dependent on Magic Eden backend services are no longer supported; remaining Solana API endpoints are outside this event.

records.notes: Primary policy notice retrospectively confirms a March 27 cutoff. Do not infer a shutdown of all Magic Eden APIs.
records.quote_or_summary: Magic Eden states the Bitcoin API and all related backend services shut down after March 27, while Solana API remains operational pending further evaluation. No migration tooling or replacement infrastructure is offered.
